notes.title: Update Version 1.7
notes.content:
[b]New Stage: Claw-some Catch! 🕹️✨[/b]
[list]
[*]A brand-new claw machine challenge awaits!
[/list]
[b]Updated Player Model & Improved Animations 🔄[/b]
[list]
[*]The character model has been redesigned with smoother and more natural animations.
[/list]
[b]Adjusted Secret Stage Difficulty 👻[/b]
[list]
[*] Slowed down ghost movement.
[/list]
[b]Fixed Endless Mode Issue 🔧[/b]
[list]
[*] Stages now load correctly in Endless Mode.
[/list]
[b]Added 3 New Achievements 🏆[/b]

[b][h2]📢 Developer's Note[/h2][/b]
I originally planned to add a Home Mode, but since it requires a lot of time to develop, I’ve decided to put it on hold for now. If more players join in, I’ll bring it back in the future! For now, I'd rather work on my next game project.

Thank you for your support! 🙏🎮( •̀ ω •́ )✧

notes.title: Update Version 1.6.5
notes.content:
🔧 [b]Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]I have fixed the game freezing issue that occurred at the end of a level.
[*]Adjusted the star system:
[list]
[*]Stars in the store can no longer go below 0.
[*]If a player currently has negative stars, their stars will be reset to 0 after updating.
[/list]
[/list]
👀 [b]Performance Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*]I have improved overall stability and performance for a smoother experience.
[/list]
[b]Thanks for all your feedback![/b]✨
//You can report any issues or share your feedback in the Community Hub under the [Discussions] section. (o゜▽゜)o☆
